correctness.rationale: For real unweighted centered-ball maximal operator on C5, each vertex may choose one of radii 0,1,2, giving an exact max of 3^5=243 row-wise averaging matrices. Nonnegative Gram matrices permit positive Perron extremizers. Rational LDL positivity at tau=1463/1000 is a finite exhaustive certificate for all 238 nonwinning patterns; the other five are rotations of (2,2,0,1,0). The winner reduces on (a,a,b,c,b) to the generalized cubic 225t^3-390t^2+91t-4, whose isolated Perron root t is 1.465662645..., and strict active-ball inequalities and simplicity classify the five rays up to scaling/signs. Independently reconstructed all 243 matrices and eigenvalues: exactly five maximizers; next squared norm 1.461197014917107 < tau < 1.465662645093066. This exhaustive finite computation supports the finite C5 theorem; it does not extrapolate to other graph sizes.
